run_dino_training: run DINO self-supervised training on an ImageNet dataset with a ViT-small architecture and multi-crop augmentation
run_dino_training_custom_arch: run DINO training with a custom architecture like vit_base or xcit and 200 epochs
run_dino_training_no_multicrop: run DINO training with multi-crop disabled by setting local_crops_number to zero
review_DINOLoss: review the DINOLoss class which computes cross-entropy between teacher and student softmax outputs with centering
review_DataAugmentationDINO: review the DataAugmentationDINO class that generates two global crops and multiple local crops with augmentations
